```artifact
Feature: Self-Test Suite for U15_Self_Test

  Scenario: Validate flow sensor accuracy
    Given the blower is set to a certain speed
    And air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is run
    Then the flow sensor accuracy should be validated
    And the expected flow should be recorded

  Scenario: Validate pressure sensor accuracy
    Given the pressure sensor is in operation
    When the self-test is run
    Then the pressure sensor accuracy should be validated
    And the expected pressure should be recorded

  Scenario: Support pre-test mode in controller
    Given the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode is initiated
    Then the controller should switch to pre-test mode
    And the pre-test mode should be confirmed

  Scenario: Support pre-test mode in GUI
    Given the GUI is open
    And the controller is in normal mode
    When the pre-test mode is initiated from the GUI
    Then the GUI should display the pre-test mode
    And the controller should switch to pre-test mode
    And the pre-test mode should be confirmed

  Scenario Outline: Controller's pre-test mode checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the following checks are performed: <checks>
    Then the checks should pass
    And the results should be recorded

    Examples:
      | checks |
      | Check 1 |
      | Check 2 |
      | Check 3 |
```
